decisions.mark: names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive that stops the compiler from knowing a value, and locates it in library/constant_time_impl.h
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` is an empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` when GNU asm is available (`library/constant_time_impl.h:85-93`). Otherwise it XORs with a `volatile` zero global (`library/constant_time.c:29`), so the compiler cannot prove a value at compile time and cannot turn masks back into branches. | WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive hiding values from the compiler and locates it in library/constant_time_impl.h.
